title: Theme min_touch_size constants are written and pinned but consumed by no runtime code
evidence:
game/themes/street_theme.tres:84-85:
Button/constants/min_touch_size = 160
Button/constants/min_touch_size_secondary = 120

The only reader anywhere under game/ is the pin test:
game/tests/test_economy.gd:969:	check(theme.get_constant("min_touch_size", "Button") == FinLitTouchTargets.MIN_TOUCH_PRIMARY,
game/tests/test_economy.gd:971:	check(theme.get_constant("min_touch_size_secondary", "Button") == FinLitTouchTargets.MIN_TOUCH_SECONDARY,

No script or scene calls get_constant("min_touch...") — grep over game/scripts/ and game/scenes/ returns only touch_targets.gd's own min_touch_size() function. Actual UI sizing is hardcoded independently:
game/scenes/street.tscn:199: custom_minimum_size = Vector2(160, 200)   # DominantButton
game/scripts/street.gd:569: 	button.custom_minimum_size = Vector2(120, 150)   # _make_big_button
game/scripts/street.gd:757: 	reset.custom_minimum_size = Vector2(0, 110)
detail: Read only by the pin test; runtime sizing uses hardcoded literals in street.tscn/street.gd. The theme mirror looks like the source but drives nothing — FinLitTouchTargets plus the scene test already enforce the real floors, so the mirror adds no guarantee.
recommended_fix: Drop the theme constants — the scene test against FinLitTouchTargets already enforces real sizes — OR read them in _make_big_button/DominantButton via theme.get_constant so the mirror is consumed, not just pinned.
